name: Core
summary: Shared basics every module may use: the driver-intent contract (CarInput), JSON reading, the module registry, and the GameData autoload (content, command line, active race, scene paths). Player preferences saved on this machine (GameData.prefs, settings.cfg) with a registry of the options the Settings screen shows (GameData.register_setting), and Units for showing speed, power, temperature, distance and fuel in the player's units.
notes: Nothing game-specific. Changes here affect everyone, so keep them rare and additive.
